chunks: And from him, from Abdullah ibn Jabala and Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ibn Bukayr, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
The pregnant woman is divorced with one divorce.
ai.seo_question: How many divorce pronouncements are required to finalize the divorce of a pregnant woman according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that a pregnant woman is divorced by a single pronouncement (taliqah wahidah), a ruling derived from the Quranic verse 'and those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth' (65:4). This establishes that the iddah for pregnancy is independent of the number of revocable divorces, distinguishing it from the standard three-month waiting period for non-pregnant women.
